message.content: Buddhism was founded by **Siddhartha Gautama**, who is commonly known as **the Buddha**. He was born in the 6th–5th century BCE in what is now modern-day Nepal, in the region of Lumbini. After attaining enlightenment, he taught his insights in the Indian subcontinent, and his teachings spread throughout ancient India and beyond. Thus, Buddhism originated in **ancient India (specifically the Lumbini region, present‑day Nepal)**.
